'''Hothog''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Grillhog]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Searhog]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The biggest problem with carrying around so much delicious food is the Zobos who always come sniffing around. Figured they had lost their sense of smell. I guess this proves a love for hot pot is simply universal."

Hothog is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Hothog's evolution trials unlock once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Searhog]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 20,000 energy drinks.
* Feed 60 Lava Ramen.

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "When your Hothog gets hurt, don't be surprised when it yells, 'You cannot eat me with a knife & fork!'"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When your Hothog gets hurt, don't be shocked when...Don't even think about it!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Hothog has grown used to the spicy hot pot and loves inviting other Tatari for a bath. No one has ever shown up, though."
